note: Generated by `pnpm sync:agents`. `agents` maps each prompt version (src/agent/prompts/) to its remote agent id, per provider: `provider` names which API owns the id and is absent on entries written before Vapi existed, where it means "elevenlabs". Versions whose provider has no remote object (openai) never appear there. `mcpServers` (present only once some version grants `mcpTools`) maps a GRANT SET — the sorted tool names, joined — to the ElevenLabs MCP server registration serving it; agents point at those ids via `mcpServerIds`, which is how a registration that moved gets noticed. Committed so every environment shares the same ids. Do not hand-edit ids or hashes.
